title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.14
exact_target: For every $n$, can one choose coefficients $\varepsilon_k\in\{-1,1\}$ so that $P(z)=\sum_{k=1}^n\varepsilon_kz^k$ satisfies $\min_{|z|=1}|P(z)|>C_2\sqrt n$ for an absolute $C_2>0$? The stronger version asks for such a lower bound together with an upper bound $\max_{|z|=1}|P(z)|<C_1\sqrt n$ with an absolute $C_1$.
